top_signals.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Set for Rare APEC Trilateral Talks
top_signals.summary: US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to hold a rare trilateral meeting Thursday on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Reporting from Shenzhen, Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle says that while the White House is framing the talks around denuclearization, the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran are likely to come up in discussions. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Goldman, Morgan Stanley Split on Yen Outlook on Diverging Forces
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Morgan Stanley are taking opposing views on the yen, highlighting the increasing difficulty in forecasting a currency being pulled in different directions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Megaspeed is suspected of helping Chinese firms get around U.S. export controls by buying Nvidia chips and routing them to China.
